mapper.select: SELECT * FROM smart_health_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY data_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, user_id, data_time, heart_rate FROM smart_health_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND heart_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY data_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, user_id, data_time, blood_pressure_high, blood_pressure_low FROM smart_health_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND blood_pressure_high IS NOT NULL AND blood_pressure_low IS NOT NULL ORDER BY data_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, user_id, data_time, blood_sugar FROM smart_health_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND blood_sugar IS NOT NULL ORDER BY data_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, user_id, data_time, sleep_time, deep_sleep_time, light_sleep_time, heart_rate, blood_pressure_high, blood_pressure_low, blood_sugar FROM smart_health_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sleep_time > 0 ORDER BY data_time DESC LIMIT 1
